// diagnostic

E0101

This program has no `run` function

What

This program has no `run` function

Why

Running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one

Fix

add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0101: tests/ui/E1130_kernel_proof.stderr.

Error [E0101]: this program has no `run` function
 Why: running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one
 Fix: add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file
